failure_patterns: Pair-only packing (extra=0) gives Sall = S: dev 83.3 -> 92.3 and dev200 83.8 -> 93.8 against round-1 pkd_b2. Against routed B pair_r1b: dev 92.3 vs 93.2 (-0.9 S), dev200 93.8 vs 93.1 (+0.7 S), Sall +8.4 / +10.0. Dev S is saturated (ceiling about 93.8), so the formal +2 dev bar cannot be met; the case is Sall.

The newest value is paraphrased without question words and never becomes a mention. Dev vehicle model: 'switched to a Ford F-150' has fused rank 15 and coverage 0.25; the CE gate removes the wrong SSD newest (CF1 0.5 -> 1) but PA stays 0. Test: the long-run recap (BM25 rank 142) and rooms renovated are not found.

Episodic or noise restatements beat the planted habitual update. Test laps: 'did 40 laps today' is protected over 'increased my morning swim to 30 laps'. Rent: 'only 9,000, shared' is picked after 'now pay 22,000'.

Requests about the attribute become the newest. Test job title: 'I'd like to know more about the role of a Marketing Director'. Every own mention has CE about -11, so the gate is blind. Excluding requests and questions outright costs -3 S on dev and -3.6 on dev200, because dev asides sit inside question sentences.
Old-value choice among repeated values costs CF1 only. Dev 'camera lens' (two 70-200mm sessions) and 'short stories' have CF1 0.5 with PA 1.
ssu questions misrouted to ku ('What book am I currently reading?') get a 2-cite pair against 1 gold session: CF1 .67 and PA 0, for both A and B.

A sentence-CE gate on all own mentions changes the packed units (dev -2.7 to -5.6). Restricted to vetoing the newest, it cost dev200 -2.9 until two protections were added: a first-person restatement of the same quantity within 10 logits of the top (Instagram 1250 -> 'close to 1300'), and name-link updates (accountant Marta -> Bruno).
core_requests: Routing config: route ku to lenses/ku/a_r2.py cenq5_dp, or give B a pair-only pack (extra=0). B's 2 context sessions cost about 10 Sall on the routed slice (B dev 88.8 / Sall 79.1, dev200 91.4 / 81.9; A 85.0 / 85.0 and 91.3 / 91.3).
Pipeline / abstention: use lenses.ku.a_r2.abstain_p(q, hx) as the routed ku abstain signal (AUC .904 dev / .943 dev200). No hint to Reactor.

Add hx.sentences(uid): a cached sentence split plus a sentence-keyed CE cache, so a CE admission pass over the top-30 units is cheap. Each question now sends 50-150 sentences to rerank_texts, and a cold call takes 0.5-1 s.
next_ideas: CE admission, not only the veto: sentences of the top-30 user and recap units with CE >= top-2 join the mentions (dev vehicle F-150, test long-run recap). Gate it on dev200.
Single cite for ssu misroutes: when the timeline has no own older mention with a different value, cite only the newest. Measure it on the --route slice.
Prefer habitual or change statements ('increased my morning swim to 30', 'now', 'usually') over one-off events ('did 40 laps today') for 'each morning / these days' questions.
Per-owner totals ('neighbor Bjorn and I in total'): one timeline per owner, a summed computed value, and relative updates ('2 more') applied to the previous value.
Calibrate abstain_p on dev+dev200 pooled (10 unanswerables), adding B's coverage-miss signal.

failure_patterns: Order questions ('which first, X or Y') lose ATR to restatements in other turns of the same session, and lose ALL when gold also includes a third same-day restatement session. Examples: bus vs train ATR 0.5, Europe vs Thailand trip ATR 0.5, Page Turners vs Marketing Professionals ALL 0, Rachel engaged vs anniversary ALL 0. Tight packing for order questions (ct_evo) made this worse: dev order PA 0.87 -> 0.81.

Aggregate 'how many months have passed since I last ...' questions match the gap regex but parse no events. They fall to topic mode with 19-26 passages: museum with a friend PA 0 and Sall 2; two charity events in a row Sall 37. There are none on test.

Gold that disagrees with the calendar: flu -> 10th jog is 81 days (11.6 weeks) but gold says 15; the new rounding gate withholds it. Airbnb in San Francisco 'months ago': the pick is an assistant sentence dated by its session (ago_gate now withholds it), and the real event sentence is not found by BM25.

Test: 3 of 35 gap questions are probably unanswerable: trail run and travel vaccines (only Camille did them), and first loaf (no mention). They now get no computed value and no number in the hint, with abstain_p 0.6-0.7. The integrator can still add an abstention policy for them.
Whole-question (B) route: 41 dev questions with no parsed events still score S 61.6 / 74.5 (gardening activity two weeks ago, business milestone four weeks ago). That route belongs to B.
core_requests: configs/best.json: set the temporal route to lenses/temporal/a_gap.py variant ct_evgba, replacing merged_r1 gapA_semB. It uses the same gap regex and calls B's b_sem sem_turns9 for questions without events, so it is a drop-in replacement. Against merged_r1: dev S +3.0 and Sall +4.3; dev200 S +0.6 and Sall +2.9; routed dev 77.9 -> 80.6.
harness.sweep: add --qfilter <regex> (or --subset gap) so a merged lens can be scored on a question subset. Today this needs scratch scripts (scratch_a/r2/sub.py).
Metrics: temporal PA = ALL and (HA if computed else ATR), so a correct computed value earns nothing and a wrong one costs PA. Please also report computed coverage (computed / answerable) next to HA.

Abstention: A's abstain_p is discrete (0.05 / 0.25 / 0.6 / 0.75 / 0.8) and loses AUC to ties when pooled with B's continuous scores. Please calibrate per route (isotonic on dev+dev200) before setting thresholds in configs/abstain.json.
next_ideas: Order questions: add each event's restatement mentions and the opening user turn of every session that mentions an event, then try a tight pack plus restatements.
Parse 'how many months have passed since I last X' as ago with 'last' semantics (newest own mention of X, with a companion filter) instead of topic mode.

Reschedule guard for tight packs: when a pick is a scheduled future date, add any later own mention of the same event with a different date as the runner-up. None exists on test today; it is a cheap safety net.

Keep the CE tie-break (ce_tb, variant ctc / ct_evgbc) as an option. It is neutral offline, raises the margins of correct test picks, and moves the trail-run pick onto Camille's purchase, which the who:other gate then blocks.

Check the hint wording and the tight 2-session packs against real Reactor answers on a small dev sample, if the organisers allow it. The offline metric cannot see the benefit of correct computed values or the removed bait numbers.

failure_patterns: The ssa type is saturated: PA = CF1 = 1.0 on dev and dev200, and the S ceiling is 95 - chars/3200. r2_conf2 vs the round-1 best recqs_cf7: S +0.3 dev / +0.4 dev200, Sall +1.0 / +0.8 (92.6 -> 93.6, 92.9 -> 93.7), chars -19% / -22%. That is below the 2-point bar; it is chosen on the tie rule (fewer chars) and on Sall.

The best turn is not the gold turn in about 1/3 of dev questions (Bandung Nasi Goreng: gold 4 turns earlier; tea tree oil: +8). Flat budget cuts below 6k lose PA (r2_s55 dev PA 0.982). Too-tight tiers cut long gold turns mid-way (r2_conf3: AC 0.957, PA 0.964 / 0.909, e.g. the '27th of 100 prompt parameters' item deep in a 5k turn). Only margin-gated tiers are safe: turn_margin >= 1.3 means best turn == gold 16/16 on dev and 4/4 on dev200.

Routing: 50 dev gold-ssa questions without a cue are routed to ssu and score S 70.1 there. With the a_handoff nf50a hand-off they score 88.9, with no loss on any non-ssa dev question. One wrong hand-off on dev200: an impersonal user fact, 'How long did it take to move to the new apartment?'. With the tighter r2_conf2 budget it also loses its user turn, so the hand-off target should be the session-filling recqs_cf7.

Remaining misses on other routes are ssa questions with a first-person word or a borderline score. 'Which show was my example of Netflix...' is routed to temporal. 'Who was the President's Chief Advisor ... fusion breakthrough?' has p_assistant 0.49, so it stays with the ssu lens, which finds the session but not the turn (PA 0).

abstain_p cannot be calibrated on this route: dev and dev200 have 0 unanswerable questions routed to ssa. The kind gate caps 6 answerable dev questions at 0.35 (down from 0.6-0.7), and nothing scores above 0.7 on any split. On test: 22 x 0.05 and 3 x 0.35.
core_requests: Put lenses/ssa/a_handoff.py variant nf50a on the ssu route in configs/best.json (or add the equivalent role_guess hook in lenses/pipeline.py: if route == 'ssu' and handoff(q, hx): use the ssa lens). The ssu_lens / ssu_variant parameters default to the current ssu winner (a_struct nb3t0) and can point at whatever wins ssu this round. Measured on the routed-to-ssu set: dev 74.4 -> 82.4 (Sall 75.8 -> 84.2, AUC 0.837 -> 0.931), dev200 72.6 -> 75.9 (Sall 73.8 -> 77.3, AUC 0.838 -> 0.892). Test-neutral: 0 of 45 test ssu-routed questions are handed off.

Switch the ssa route to a_recsent r2_conf2. Together with the hand-off, the routed system goes from dev 80.4 to 82.6 (Sall 74.9 -> 77.3) and dev200 from 79.8 to 81.0 (Sall 74.2 -> 75.5), measured with lenses/ssa/a_routed.py and the proposal config lenses/ssa/scratch_a/routed_r2a.json.
harness.sweep: write mean chars into summary.json under the same key as the leaderboard (chars_mean). summary.json has no chars key today.
next_ideas: Fit role_guess as a logistic regression on dev and validate it on dev200 (it is hand-weighted now). Add an 'impersonal user fact' feature (a definite article plus a personal-life noun such as 'the new apartment' or 'the move') to block the one wrong hand-off.

Evidence-based hand-off from the temporal and multi routes as well (ssa questions misrouted there: 'my example of Netflix', 'How many mummies...'). This needs per-route rules, because a wrong move off multi is expensive.
A round-level turn score (user question + assistant answer) for the turn_margin signal, so more questions qualify for the 3000-char tier without PA loss.
Have the integrator check the quoted-line hint against Reactor on about 10 test-style questions. It fires on 23 of 25 test ssa questions and offline metrics cannot see its effect.

failure_patterns: Gold-type ssu is saturated. r3rn ties the r1 winner nb3t0: dev S 93.4 vs 93.5, dev200 92.5 vs 92.5. Sall is 92.7/89.7 vs 93.2/90.7 (-0.5/-1.0, within the 2-point limit). AUC is 0.919/0.955 vs 0.911/0.909. The ceiling is about S 93.9, so a +2 win on gold-type dev is impossible.

Routed ssu route (--route --type ssu, tag r2-ssu-a-route), nb3t0 -> r3rn: dev S 74.4 -> 82.6, Sall 75.8 -> 84.2; dev200 S 72.6 -> 78.5, Sall 73.8 -> 79.1. By gold type on dev: ssa 70.1 -> 86.1, ku 69.7 -> 77.4, multi 43.3 -> 49.7.

KU misroutes: the update session scores 6-10 logits below the top session but far above the noise floor, so sess_gap=6 dropped it. Session scores: 'cocktail-making class day' [3.6, -2.9G, -8.3]; 'previous language exchange tutor Juan' [6.5, -0.3G, -10.1]; 'mom grocery list method' [6.9, -3.3G, -9.9]. Fixed by the outlier runner-up rule (s2>-6 and s2-s3>3, pack only): it fires on 28/34 ku (27 gold) and 8/62 ssu. ku PA on dev 0.80 -> 0.92.

ssa misroutes: the right session is cited (CF1 1.0), but the answer sits in an assistant turn the user-only pool never packed ('fashion brand wild rubber': user logit -7.5, all-roles logit +7.3). Fixed by packing the best all-roles assistant unit when it beats the best user logit by 2: ssa PA on dev 0.64 -> 0.88. Still failing: list-position questions ('fifth gin bottle', 'chess move after 27. Kg2').

The pair cite (cite the runner-up within 3 logits) gains +1.5 routed S on dev, but it fires on 10 of 12 audited TEST ssu packs. Test histories plant drift and decoys: cat Fig/Bica/Sombra, sourdough starter Bubbles/Herman/Masa. It is therefore off in the final variant, and KU pairs keep CF1 at about 0.67.

Test recency bug in nb3t0: 'speaker impedance / AM IF did I end up using in my National R-77' jumped to the later 07/14 session that only says 'briefly tried a 22k-ohm screen grid resistor'. rec_need now requires the later session to state the attribute: AM IF cites 07/09 'realigned the AM IF to 465 kHz', and the speaker question cites the 05/19 new-speaker session.
Unflagged perceive decoy: 'I saw a sourdough starter named Herman in a French baking forum' is the top unit (+3.98). The recency rule still picks 'renamed my sourdough starter Masa'.

Abstention: pooled routed AUC 0.827 -> 0.882 from the all-roles prior, followed by Platt calibration (a=0.5, c=-2). Test packs with abstain_p>=0.5 drop from 8 of 45 to 0. Precision at p>=0.3 is 3/8, still below the re-enable rule. The INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE hint line is removed, per policy.
core_requests: harness.sweep --route should write to its own path (e.g. runs/<tag>/<type>-routed/...). Today a routed run silently overwrites the gold-type run that has the same tag.
Add a per-gold-type breakdown (S, Sall, PA, CF1) to the routed sweep output. scratch_a/r2_bytype.py does this; misroute effects are invisible in the route mean.
Add harness.audit --compare <old run>: list the test packs whose cite_plan or passage count changed (scratch_a/r2_cmp_test.py). This is how the pair-cite problem and the recency fix were found.
Answer-anchored citation on the submission side (carried over).
Wire configs/best.json ssu -> lenses/ssu/a_struct2.py / r3rn. It reuses the cached generic hybrid_rr all-roles pool; build takes about 110 ms on dev and 370 ms on dev200.
next_ideas: Gate the pair cite on value disagreement: cite both sessions only when both best units are affirmed own statements of the same attribute with different extracted values (number, day, time, duration). Never cite both on name drift. Evaluate on routed dev and the test audit together.

Name-drift voting (cat Fig/Bica/Sombra): count affirmed own mentions per value, prefer replies to 'What's her name?', break ties by recency, and name the value in the hint only when one clearly leads.
Perceive decoys: extend PERCEIVE_RX to 'I saw/read about a X named Y' with owner=other.
ssa list-position questions (ordinal cues 'fifth', 'number 7', 'last on the list'): pack the assistant chunk that holds the list plus the next chunk.
Merge with lens B: B's all-roles session sweep for recall, plus A's structure, the attribute-checked recency jump and the outlier runner-up.

failure_patterns: Baseline is B deep8_10k run through this file (b_ref): Sall 73.9 dev / 73.5 dev200. The generic hybrid_rr baseline was reused from the r2-multi-b run: dev S 69.1, dev200 S 63.7.

r2best Sall (if Reactor cites every passage): 84.0 dev (+10.1 over b_ref), 78.9 dev200 (+5.4). CF1all 0.473 -> 0.790 dev and 0.487 -> 0.734 dev200. Passages per question 8.1 -> 4.4 dev, 11.7 -> 7.3 on test.
Routed multi: dev S 83.0 / Sall 79.9 vs b_ref 82.6 / 69.7; dev200 S 78.8 / Sall 75.6 vs 79.5 / 67.2. On the whole routed system that is about S +0.1 / -0.2 and Sall +3.1 / +2.8.

The only dev200 loss (also the only extra dev loss against B) is an instance session with weak CE that falls outside the CE core. In 'How many properties did I view before making an offer on the townhouse in Brookside', 5 gold sessions score CE 4.1, 1.5, -3.2, -9.5, -10.3. The 'Cedar Creek on February 1st' session sits 14 logits below the top, and no rank, lexical or statement-CE feature separates it.
Category -> instance gaps inherited from B: 'projects I led' vs a case competition and a poster presentation; 'health-related devices' vs hearing aids ranked 5th inside its own session.

Test: instance sentences buried in chatty units get unit-level CE about -11. In 'books read since March', 'I just finished reading a book about the history of Sao Paulo' is in neither B's pack nor mine; 14 chatty book sessions in the core use up the budget.

Test: CE scores are flat across 200-session histories, so the core often reaches the 14-session cap (ceramic pieces 11 passages, orchids 13, phone calls 14). The Sall gain on test will be smaller than on dev.

Abstention (facet-absence noisy-OR): pooled AUC 0.689 -> 0.739. At p>=0.4 precision is 7/7 at recall 0.39 on gold-type questions, but only 8/14 at recall 0.42 on routed questions, below the re-enable rule, so no abstention hint was added.

Code-side ledger in the hint (brief item 3) picks wrong or incomplete sentences on dev (e.g. 'great list of questions to ask my doctor'; 2 of 4 health devices). Not recommended; decoy filtering was moved into the pack instead: 12 decoy sessions dropped across 8 of the 20 multi-routed test questions, all inspected and real decoys. Dev-neutral.
core_requests: Decide the multi citation policy: cite_plan post-filter vs Reactor's own [E#]. For multi it decides between r2best (S roughly a tie, +10 Sall) and B deep8_10k.
build_pack / B _select: support pinned sentence-level instances (a pinned unit rendered as only its instance sentence, ~150 chars) that enter a budget-bound pack ahead of chatty depth units.
harness.failures: print the session-strength rank of each MISSING gold session (lens saves debug.strength / debug.core / debug.extra).
Add passages_mean to summary.json and leaderboard.csv; it drives Sall directly.
next_ideas: Pinned instance sentences: use sentence-level CE relative to a sentence-level top (lexical >= 2.5, own, declarative, not declined) and pin them ahead of core depth units, targeting buried test facts (the Sao Paulo book case).
Test-adaptive core: when more than 8 sessions sit within 4 logits of the top (flat CE), require a lexical instance hit for core membership, to shrink the 11-14 passage test packs.
Let B import a_abstain.facet_absence (AUC +0.05 pooled). Add a scaffolding-verb stop list (exceed, end up, varieties) to the pair-absence check to remove test noise.
Alternative if Sall decides: p8x1_ddl15 (recall slot needs lexical >= 1.5) gives dev 86.8 / 84.7, dev200 83.2 / 80.1.
Ledger hint only after a Reactor spot check; pack-level decoy dropping already covers its purpose at zero chars.

failure_patterns: Test: updates paraphrased without the attribute noun are never retrieved, so the pack misses the new value. Examples: job title -> 'another promotion, so now I am Director of Clinical Services'; long run -> assistant recap 'Sundays at 6:30 a.m.'; laps (only '40 laps' restatements are found). These are the low-margin packs, and the extra context session rarely holds the update.

Test: another person's value fills the old-value slot when the user's own old statement is not in the candidate pool. Example: coffee, where the pack pairs 'Carlos drinks three cups' with the user's 'switched to one cup'. Variant r2c labels the Carlos sentence as someone else's but the pair does not change, because every other candidate is weak too.

Dev, low-margin pairs (CF1 lost, PA kept by the gate): camera lens (two 70-200mm mentions compete); kitchen gadget before the Air Fryer ('my new Instant Pot' shares no words with the question); gym frequency (the new value sits in a smoothie sentence, and the reranker prefers an assistant question containing 'more frequently').

Bigram abstention also fires on answerable test phrasings ('job title', 'monthly rent', 'freelance taxes', "skateboard's name"). It is usable as a ranking score (AUC 0.887->0.926 dev, 0.886->0.898 dev200) but must not drive a hint to Reactor.

The gate is stricter on test than on dev: 12 of 20 test KU packs fall below the 3.5 margin and get pair + 1 session, against 5 of 72 on dev. If those pairs are right, test KU CF1all should be about 0.88, against 0.667 for pair_r1b.
core_requests: Route ku to lenses/ku/b_r2.py variant r2b in configs/best.json. Gains: S +0.2 on both splits, Sall +9.7 on dev (83.9 -> 93.6) and +8.9 on dev200 (83.8 -> 92.7), about 600 fewer chars, higher abstention AUC. b_r2 imports lenses/ku/b_semantic.py; its new OWN_NAME flag defaults to off, so pair_r1b is unchanged.

Router: wire lenses/ku/b_r2.ku_pair_p (two different values, weaker pair member score >= 6, min coverage >= 0.5) into the SSU route only. On 40-question dev samples it fires on ku 40/78, multi 2/40, ssu 0/40. A multi->ku misroute costs about 70 S, so never apply it to multi-routed questions. Re-measure on full dev and dev200 ssu before wiring.
Submission: on low-confidence KU packs (pair + 1), citing all 3 sessions does slightly better on dev (CF1all 0.986 against 0.979 for the pair alone), so cite-everything is safe for KU now.
next_ideas: Attribute-paraphrase second hop: run a sentence-level reranker (hx.rerank_texts) over value-bearing own sentences of the top 60 user units plus assistant recaps, scored against the declarative attribute. Admit a session to the pair only if it states a value of the same type as the old member (time, count, title or name). Targets the test misses: job title, long run, laps.
Own-value constraint in the pair: when a pair member is someone else's value, replace it with the best own sentence carrying the same value type, or fall back to a single-session pack plus the hint.
Per-owner timelines and a summed computed value for 'X and I in total' questions (the Bjørn horses question).
Calibrate abstain_p on dev and dev200 pooled; count the bigram signal only together with low coverage, so answerable phrase variants are not pushed up.

failure_patterns: Mixed result on the acceptance rule. Against the R1 best deep8_10k (dev 86.6 / Sall 73.9, dev200 85.2 / Sall 73.5), p08c35_aor scores dev S 87.2 / Sall 85.7 (+0.6 / +11.8) and dev200 S 83.3 / Sall 82.3 (-1.9 / +8.8). Routed multi on dev: S 83.1 / Sall 81.8 against 82.6 / 69.7. The dev200 S loss is one question out of 22 answerable.

Pruning can drop gold sessions on category-to-instance questions with many gold sessions, because those sessions sit 7-14 CE logits below the top and at fused rank 6-15. Examples: 'properties viewed before the townhouse offer' (5 gold sessions; two have p(gold) 0.07 and 0.006, so the pack keeps 3; this is the dev200 loss and it also fails on dev); 'furniture bought/assembled/sold/fixed' (4th gold session p 0.03, term coverage 0); 'years in formal education' (3rd gold session at rank 6, p 0.05).
Gold sessions that never enter the hybrid pool remain, carried over from round 1: 'projects I led' should reach the case competition and the poster sessions.

Test-style repeated-measurement counts ('systolic > 130 in August', 'phone calls with my daughter in August') keep only 6 sessions. The number of in-window mentions may be larger than the cap of 8. This cannot be validated on dev, where the window prior is off because histories span fewer than 45 days.
Sentence-level CE (hx.rerank_texts, max-fused into the session score) gave no gain: -0.6 S on dev and +-0 on dev200.
Abstention is now a noisy-OR with multi-A's absence check. AUC: dev 0.644 -> 0.731, routed 0.668 -> 0.758, dev200 0.833 -> 0.795 (only 6 unanswerable questions on dev200).
core_requests: Decide the multi cite policy with Sall in view. p08c35_aor packs nearly exactly the cite set (Sall within 1.5 of S on dev and within 1.0 on dev200). If Reactor's own citations are submitted, route b_tight p08c35_aor instead of b_sweep deep8_10k (+11.8 Sall on dev, +8.8 on dev200, +12.1 on routed dev).
Optional: save each lens's question analysis (kind, facets) in per_question.jsonl, so threshold fits per kind can run offline without re-running analyze().
next_ideas: Adaptive breadth for windowed counts on test: when the window prior is active and kind == count, keep every in-window session with p >= tk/2, up to 12 sessions. Validate it with the test audit and a Reactor spot check.

Instance expansion for category questions: multi-A's LEXICON plus hx.dense_texts over the user sentences of sessions ranked 4-15, added as an extra feature in the p(gold) model. Refit on dev only and validate on dev200.

Richer p(gold) features: whether the best unit states a first-person fact with a number, facet-hit flags and the window flag. Refit the logistic model (scratch_b/keep_fit.py) on dev and keep dev200 as the holdout.
A soft hint, 'cite only the passages that contain a counted item', once a Reactor spot check is allowed. It matters less now that the pack is about 3.5 sessions for about 2.8 gold.

failure_patterns: Whole-question route: the gold sets include same-category sessions at other dates, and those rank 14-24 under the anchor time prior, so ALL fails. Examples: 'Who did I go with to the music event last Saturday?' (rank 14), 'cooking something for my friend a couple of days ago' (rank 18), 'life event of one of my relatives a week ago' (rank 24). Interleaving the plain-CE ranking lifted route ALL from 0.846 to 0.897.

Whole-question packs are wide: 13.8 passages for about 3 gold sessions (CF1all 0.35). Every session cap tried costs ALL: top-5 drops route ALL from 0.85 to 0.64; a cap of 8 costs 1.4 S on dev for +2.1 Sall on dev200.

Event-route 'ago' questions with an explicit date in the question or a long span: 'March 15th issue' computed 17 vs gold 12/13; 'months ago Airbnb San Francisco' computed 0 vs gold 5. 'Which group did I join first' misses one gold session (ALL 0).

B's raw gap picks can be garbage at high margin confidence. Test sourdough question: picks were 'Sourdough croissants' and a 'Meatloaf' recipe, giving 58. A content-word, subject and date-order guard now rejects it; dev/dev200 are unchanged and all 6 dev fallbacks have HA = 1.
core_requests: Point the temporal route in configs/best.json at lenses/temporal/b_merge.py:ev1_mix_g. It contains merged_r1 as variant 'base', so A's gap route is untouched apart from the guarded fallback. Add harness.sweep --filter <regex> or --qids <file> to sweep subsets such as gap vs non-gap without post-hoc scripts (today: lenses/temporal/scratch_b/sub.py).
Coordinate with temporal-A's gap-pack trim (brief A2). A's gap packs average 4.4 passages (dev gap subset S 84 vs Sall 79); b_merge picks up A's changes through load_lens with no edit.

Retry the w_today prior (units that date their own event: 'today', 'just') on the mix ranking.

lens_file: lenses/ssa/b_role.py (role detector + routed wrapper, recommended variant switch_m8m9); ssa lens lenses/ssa/b_semantic.py (session10k1_rr / session10k1_rrp); report lenses/ssa/b_report.md
best_variant: b_role.py switch_m8m9. role_guess(q, hx) = sigmoid(0.35*clip(CE_best_assistant - CE_best_user, ±8) + 2.2*[no first-person word] - 1.2). It switches ssu-routed questions at p>=0.8 and multi-routed ones at p>=0.9 to the ssa lens (A recqs_cf7). Routed system: dev S 80.4->83.3 (Sall 74.9->78.0, AUC .719->.750); dev200 79.9->82.8 (Sall 74.2->77.2, AUC .808->.825). FP 0 on both splits; 0 test questions switched. ssa-type lens: b_semantic session10k1_rr (ties A; keep A recqs_cf7 on the ssa route). The dev/dev200 numbers below are this lens on gold ssa questions.
failure_patterns: Trimming the top session to 4-5k loses the gold turn whatever the signal (unit CE, cleaned-query CE, sentence-level CE via rerank_texts). PA falls from 0.991 to 0.91-0.95 (S 88-91 vs 92.5): each miss costs 0.58 S, 1k chars saves only 0.31 S. Examples: Bandung/Miss Bee gold t7 at gold_rank 21; Fissionator user turn at gold_rank 30. Test ssa packs are already 2.0-3.4k chars (mean 2.66k), so the 4k target is met on test.
Possible gold-turn label noise: for 'Hoop Dance' (q_6fabbe9a09a6, q_4d6447a7f593) the gold turn is a user turn without the answer string. Only whole-session packs satisfy ATR.

Role-detector misses: 'President's Chief Advisor ... article' (d=-5.0, the user pasted the article; costs 64.7 S) and 'Which back-end languages should I learn' (nf=1, p=0.56). Near false positives: 'What breed is my dog?' (d=+4.65), 'Where do I take yoga classes?' (+4.68) and 'move to the new apartment' (nf0, d=-1.04). Each would cost 31-65 S if switched, hence thresholds 0.8 / 0.9. On the temporal route p>=0.7 gives 12 false switches, so the switch is never applied there or on ku.

Test (qualitative): 'homebrew supply shop you recommended' -> B cites the user's 'homebrew supply place' session; A cites the right 'You should check out Peachtree Brew Supply' session. That sentence has CE logit -8.4 and hybrid rank 99; the rec pool adds it but the speech-act bonus cannot beat the CE z. I did not tune on it; it argues for keeping A on the ssa route.
ssa type is saturated: B 92.5/93.1 vs A 93.3/93.3; both lenses send one passage, so S equals Sall.
